{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df.shape)

# Check for sentinel values
print(f"Number of customer_age == -1: {df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")

# Check revenue column: is it string with commas?
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA orders
print(f"QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]} rows")

# Check status
print(f"Status distribution: {df['status'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check customer_segment
print(f"Customer segment distribution: {df['customer_segment'].value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
